test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-5) Official Paper (Held On: 15 June 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: There are seven members in a family. D is the mother of F. D is G's father's mother. G is the brother of A, and C. F is the only son of E. How is E related to C?
solution:
**Given: **Number of members in a family = 7, namely A, B, C, D, E, F, G.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8ee8d234dd9174c974deb4cc70aa9dbcf9e13cb54fde9438ca229bee24830637.png] 

**Explanation:**

 
• D is the mother of F. 

 
• D is G's father's mother.

 
• F is the only son of E.
 
• G is the brother of A and C.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0ae1a76fb0cc4f822ea72910061ec63df9b4a7e4accc3a6619854b536df02444.png] 

 
• E is the father's father of C.

Hence, **Father's fathe**r is the **correct answer.**
